notes.title: Demo Update 0.02
notes.notes: Hello! We have added a spanish translation for the game and fixed more bugs along with some grammar and spelling errors. We also added a trigger warning at the start of the game to be more specific about triggers and to make sure those that didn't read the mature content section of the Steam page are aware of the sensitive topics in the game. Thanks for supporting Princess of Worlds End and please contact us if you encounter any more glitches or spelling/grammar errors in the demo please comment about them and include a screenshot right here in the Community hub!

notes.title: Demo Update 0.01
notes.notes: Hello, hope you all have enjoyed the demo so far! It has done much better than expected and the feedback has been very positive so far. A few playtesters ran into some minor bugs with some audio files being too loud and there was also a minor glitch with the save data. In order to fix this we had to change some of the code behind saving so their is a chance that the save files made during the demo will no longer be accessible. We apologize but there was no getting around it if we wanted to fix the glitch. If this happens to you please start a new game and make use of the shift key in order to skip text you have already read. Thanks for supporting Princess of Worlds End and please contact us at Wacol Studios if you encounter any more glitches in the demo using the email wacolstudios@outlook.com or by reaching out to us on Bluesky!
